declarations.description:
An interactive prompt for apps that take commands: dev consoles, CLI tutorials, chat-ops and admin shells. It is
not a terminal emulator — there is no PTY and no cursor addressing (use xterm.js for that), and `c2-log-viewer`
stays the read-only log.

Set `handler` to `(command, { name, args, print, signal }) => …`; it may return a string, a DOM node, a promise of
either, or an async iterable of lines, which streams in. Without a handler, listen to `command` and call
`print(text, { kind })`, where `kind` is `output`, `error`, `success` or `info`. Strings are always drawn as text,
never parsed as HTML; their ANSI colour and bold codes (SGR 30–37, 90–97, 1 and 0) are shown and every other escape
is dropped.

Built in: `clear` (also Ctrl+L) clears the screen, `help` lists `commands` when it is set, and Ctrl+C aborts the
running command's `signal` and prints `^C` (with text selected, Ctrl+C copies instead). Tab completes through
`complete(input)`, which returns whole command lines: one match fills the line, several are listed under it; with an
empty line Tab moves focus as usual. Up and Down walk earlier commands, which `history` reads and sets. While a
command runs the prompt gives way to a spinner and typing is ignored; the screen keeps the last `max-lines` lines.

The host is a region named by `heading` (or "Terminal"); the command line is a text box named by `label`; the
screen is a log that is not live itself — the terminal announces each command's output once it ends, and only a
line count when it is long. Clicking the screen focuses the command line unless text was selected. It is dark in
both themes, as a terminal reads as one, and every colour is a variable, the eight ANSI colours included.

cssProperties.description: The terminal's height; the screen scrolls inside it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal--height

cssProperties.description: The tallest the terminal grows before its screen scrolls.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal--max-height

cssProperties.description: Secondary text: the title bar, hints, the running line, `help`'s built-ins.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal__muted--color

cssProperties.description: The prompt mark and the caret.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal__prompt--color

cssProperties.description: The three window dots of the title bar.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal__dot--color

cssProperties.description: Ring while the command line has focus.
cssProperties.name: --c2-terminal__focus--outline

cssParts.description: The scrolling screen: banner, output and command line.
cssParts.name: screen

cssParts.description: The prompt on the command line.
cssParts.name: prompt

slots.description: The first lines, above every command: a product name, a welcome, a hint to type `help`.
slots.name: banner

slots.description: Shown before the prompt mark on the command line, such as a path and branch. Echoed commands keep its text.
slots.name: prompt

members.name: prompt
members.description: The prompt mark shown before each command.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the command line; "Command" when empty.

members.name: heading
members.description: Adds a title bar with this text and the Ctrl+L and Ctrl+C hints, and names the terminal.

members.name: maxLines
members.description: The most lines the screen keeps; older ones drop off.

members.name: commands
members.description: The commands `help` lists, `[{ name, description }]`. While it is empty, `help` goes to the handler like any command.

members.name: handler
members.description: Runs each command. See the class description for what it may return.

members.name: complete

type.text: (input: string) => readonly string[] | Promise<readonly string[]> | undefined

members.description: Tab completion: returns the whole command lines the input may complete to.

members.name: history
members.description: Earlier commands, oldest first. Set it to restore a session; read it to keep one.

members.name: pending
members.description: Prints made before the first render, drawn once the screen exists.

members.name: collected
members.description: The blocks the running command printed, read for the announcement when it ends.

members.name: print
members.description: Prints text (ANSI colours kept, drawn as text) or a node, as a block of the given kind.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the screen. The banner stays.

members.name: run
members.description: Runs a command as if it were typed and entered. Ignored while another command runs.

members.name: trim
members.description: Drops the oldest lines until no more than `maxLines` are kept.

members.name: echo
members.description: The echoed command: the prompt slot's text, the mark and the command.

members.name: hasSelection
members.description: Whether text is selected on the page. Chromium reports a selection inside a shadow root only on that root.

events.name: command
events.description: A command was entered (not `clear`, nor `help` while `commands` is set). `detail` is `{ command, name, args, print, signal }`; without a `handler`, print the answer from here.
